fields.name: CARD-NUM
fields.description: Card number — alphanumeric, stored as StringType to preserve leading zeros and formatting

fields.name: CARD-ACCT-ID
fields.description: Associated account identifier — unsigned zoned decimal, mapped to LongType

fields.name: CARD-CVV-CD
fields.description: CVV security code — zoned decimal but stored as StringType to preserve leading zeros

fields.name: CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME
fields.description: Name embossed on card — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.description: Card expiration date — alphanumeric date string (note: original typo preserved from copybook)

fields.name: CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS
fields.description: Active status flag (Y/N) — single alphanumeric character

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved filler bytes — unused padding to reach 150-byte record length
